NONE: › written abbreviation for government: used to show that an internet address belongs to a government organization
（網址中的一部分，表明該網站屬於政府機構，government的縮寫）

example: www.nasa.gov
（美國航空航天局網址）

I or T: B2 [ I or T ] to control and direct the public business of a country, city, group of people, etc.

T: › [ T ] to have a controlling influence on something

example: The country has been governed by military regimes.
這個國家現在由軍政府控制。
A president needs popular support in order to govern effectively.
總統需要大眾的支援方能有效治理國家。
Prices of goods are governed by the cost of the raw materials, as well as by the cost of production and distribution.
商品的價格不但取決於生產和行銷成本，而且取決於原材料的價格。

NONE: › the way that organizations or countries are managed at the highest level, and the systems for doing this
（機構或國家最高層的）管理體系

example: We aim to promote and maintain the highest standards of directorship and corporate governance.
我們致力於推廣和保持最高水準的董事和機構管理。

NONE: › (especially in the past) a woman who lives with a family and teaches their children at home
（尤指舊時的）家庭女教師

before noun: › having the power to govern a country or an organization
› having a controlling influence on something
居支配地位的，起主導作用的，佔優勢的

example: the governing body of the school
學校的管理機構
a governing principle/factor
指導原則/決定性因素

C, + sing/pl verb: B1 [ C,  + sing/pl verb ] written abbreviation govt the group of people who officially control a country

U: B2 [ U ] the system used for controlling a country, city, or group of people
B2 [ U ] the activities involved in controlling a country, city, group of people, etc.
英國女王／國王陛下的政府，英國政府

example: the government of Israel
以色列政府
The government is/are expected to announce its/their tax proposals today.
預計今天政府會公佈稅收計劃。

部長宣佈政府政策將不會有任何改變。
Senior government officials will be attending a meeting tomorrow.
政府高級官員們明天將參加一個會議。
Theatre companies are very concerned about cuts in government grants to the arts.
政府削減藝術撥款，各戲劇演出公司對此非常擔心。
A government enquiry has been launched.
政府調查已經啟動。
The 1990s saw a shift to democratic government in Eastern Europe.
20世紀90年代東歐國家紛紛向民主體制轉軌。
What this state needs is really strong government.
這個國家需要的是一個健全有力的政體。
The party that was elected to power has no experience of government.
當選上臺的這個政黨沒有執政經驗。

NONE: › relating to companies and other organizations that receive support or money from a government
（公司或機構）受政府支持的，得到政府資金的
› relating to companies and other organizations that work with special permission from their government
（公司或機構）獲得政府批准經營的

example: Overseas Private Investment Corp. is a US government-chartered corporation that provides guarantees and insurance to US companies investing in developing countries.
海外私人投資公司是一家由美國政府批准建立的公司，為在發展中國家投資經營的美國公司提供擔保和保險。

NONE: › relating to companies and other organizations that are the property of a government
（公司或機構）資產屬於政府的

example: Logging is prohibited on government-owned land.
在政府擁有的土地上砍伐樹木是被禁止的。

NONE: › relating to activities that are supported or paid for by a government
（活動）受政府支持的，受政府資助的

example: Cigarette smoking among high school students is on the rise, according to a major new US government-sponsored survey.
根據一份由政府出資完成的報告，高中學生抽煙的比率正在上升。

NONE: › belonging or relating to government or the government
政府的；和政府有關的

example: We await a governmental decision about the future of the programme.
我們正等待著政府就該專案的前途作出決定。

NONE: › a person in charge of a particular political unit
統治者；管轄者；總督；州長
› mainly UK a person in charge of or responsible for a particular organization
（某組織機構的）董事，理事，主管

example: the governor of Texas
德克薩斯州州長

gubernatorial
a prison/school governor
監獄長／學校董事

NONE: › the main representative of a country in another country that is controlled by the first country, especially the representative of the British king or queen in a country that is a member of the Commonwealth
（尤指英聯邦國家代表英國國王或女王的）總督
› the period of time that someone is a governor
州長（或總督、董事等）的任期

example: His governorship was marked by fairness and prosperity.
他任州長期間政績卓著，社會公平，經濟繁榮。
